title: Asset Hunt: load, retry, play and release
prompt: Build Asset Hunt, a complete Core-only Kurot game. Read AGENTS.md. Use only this project's supplied docs/examples and installed public APIs. No browsing, installing, upgrading or publishing. Edit only src/** and template/web/index.html; resource/**, config, SDK, docs and manifests are immutable. TypeScript strict, named exports, no any or internal APIs. Export app, the single createPlayer result, from src/Main.ts for embedding/lifecycle integration. Stage 640x800, canvas#gameCanvas. The supplied resource/default.res.json declares group round containing a PNG gem and JSON rules. Use Core resource.loadConfig/loadGroup, progress callback and cached resources; no direct fetch/XHR or manual texture generation. Start in ready. DOM buttons #start, #retry, #restart, #close have those accessible names. Start shows loading and disables gameplay until every resource is ready. Show progress in output#status data-loaded/data-total. Render the loaded PNG as a Bitmap named gem, centered at (320,360), displayed at 96x96; tapping it adds rules.points to the score. At rules.goal, phase becomes ended and further taps do nothing. Read rules from JSON on each new load; values may vary at HTTP runtime. On a load error show error and enable Retry; Retry really retries and can enter playing. Restart from ended starts a fresh round with score 0, without duplicate listeners. Close and pagehide are idempotent disposal: stop owned activity, detach input/controls, disable controls, release owned resources, and prevent in-flight completions from reviving or modifying disposed UI. If a load completes after disposal, release its owned cache entries once settled. Mirror actual state in output#status data-phase=ready|loading|error|playing|ended|disposed and data-score/data-loaded/data-total. Keep the status after Close. Visible HUD and instructions, usable at width 360. Retain CLI placeholders. You may self-check with npm run build and npm run typecheck. Do not change tests or add globals/test bridges. Deliver the working game.

acceptance.description: Fresh fixed-SDK build and strict typing succeed; public Resource and Bitmap are used.
Actual PNG/JSON requests, progress, Bitmap texture, runtime rules, score/end/restart work.
A controlled resource failure shows error and recovers via Retry.
Disposal during blocked loading never revives UI and releases late cache entries.
